trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident is open as INC-0002, and on-call has been paged.

**Rollback:**
- checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate.
- v2.3.0 is the most recent healthy release. The two releases after it, v2.3.1-rc and v2.3.1, were both marked unhealthy.
- After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0, health checks pass and the error rate is 0.2%.

**Incident:**
- INC-0002 says v2.3.1 failed health checks, the service was rolled back to v2.3.0 everywhere and it's back to normal. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before anyone redeploys it.
- My first attempt to open the incident timed out. I checked the incident list, it was empty, so I submitted again.
- The new incident got ID INC-0002 rather than INC-0001, so the first attempt may have been partly recorded. It's worth checking that no duplicate incident or page was created.
